evals.name: promotional-blurb
evals.prompt:
Rewrite the text below so it reads like it was written by a person, not an AI. Preserve every fact. Output only the rewritten text, nothing else.

Nestled within the breathtaking region of Gonder in Ethiopia, Alamata Raya Kobo stands as a vibrant town with a rich cultural heritage and stunning natural beauty. This charming destination showcases a tapestry of traditions that reflect the region's enduring legacy.
evals.expected_output: A plain, factual rewrite that drops the promotional padding. It should name the place, its region, and country, and say something simple and concrete about it. Should read like a neutral encyclopedia line.
evals.source: Nestled within the breathtaking region of Gonder in Ethiopia, Alamata Raya Kobo stands as a vibrant town with a rich cultural heritage and stunning natural beauty. This charming destination showcases a tapestry of traditions that reflect the region's enduring legacy.

evals.name: significance-padding
evals.prompt:
Rewrite the text below so it reads like it was written by a person, not an AI. Preserve every fact. Output only the rewritten text, nothing else.

evals.expected_output: A short factual sentence stating the institute was established in 1989 as part of Spain's administrative decentralization. No significance inflation, no 'pivotal', no 'broader movement' ceremony.
evals.source: The Statistical Institute of Catalonia was officially established in 1989, marking a pivotal moment in the evolution of regional statistics in Spain. This initiative was part of a broader movement across Spain to decentralize administrative functions and enhance regional governance.

evals.name: em-dash-and-aphorism
evals.prompt:
Rewrite the text below so it reads like it was written by a person, not an AI. Preserve every fact. Output only the rewritten text, nothing else.

evals.name: chatbot-collaboration
evals.prompt:
Rewrite the text below so it reads like it was written by a person, not an AI. Preserve every fact. Output only the rewritten text, nothing else.

Here is an overview of the French Revolution. I hope this helps! Let me know if you'd like me to expand on any section. The revolution began in 1789 when financial crisis and food shortages led to widespread unrest. This period marked a significant turning point in French history.
evals.expected_output: Drops the assistant-style framing ('Here is', 'I hope this helps', 'Let me know'). Keeps the 1789 facts as plain prose. No 'significant turning point' padding.
evals.source: Here is an overview of the French Revolution. I hope this helps! Let me know if you'd like me to expand on any section. The revolution began in 1789 when financial crisis and food shortages led to widespread unrest. This period marked a significant turning point in French history.
